teaser: A brief for investor.sgit.ai: investors and founders using our tools, with news, contracts as graphs, deal rooms as vaults and sgit as the case study.
core_idea: Because what we build has to be experienced to be understood, investor.sgit.ai would let investors and founders use it: news from investor circles as a graph, contracts as linked graphs, a founders' section, funding models, an evaluation framework for security startups, deal rooms as vaults, keys for investors, sgit as the case study and RiskMandate at work, run by a small agent team, built to sgit.ai's repository rules with CI owning the version, and shown to investors for their answer.
